scientific_integrity: Uniform proofs are explicit and independent of finite tests; standard-library exhaustive tests of h=1..6 corroborate face equalities and signed characters. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the inclusive scale-two vertex-metric Rips complexes of the specified graphs are classified, and only for integers h>=2; the integral homology action is proved but a literal equivariant wedge splitting is not asserted. No later scales or homotopy quotients are determined. The nonequivariant wedge result may be implied by prior general gluing criteria.
title: Two-edge hexagon books: signed sphere modules and a contractible symmetry quotient
